tools.description: Ranks the products AgentDrives has test-driven for a task given in plain words (e.g. 'send an invoice'). tools.name: get_tool
tools.description: Returns any product we drove: its full test-drive result (13 to 35 KB, usually about 19 KB; brief: true gives the headline in 2.5 to 5 KB, usually about 3 KB): how far an agent gets with it and where it stops. slug: its directory slug from search_tools, or its name or domain; an unknown one is an er

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Lists every category in the directory: its id (for search_tools' category filter), its name, the number of products listed in it and the best agent level in it (0-5).

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: find_tools_for_task, search_tools, get_tool · Private data: get_tool · Public sink: find_tools_for_task · Destructive: get_tool.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: find_tools_for_task, search_tools, get_tool · Private data: get_tool · Public sink: find_tools_for_task · Destructive: get_tool

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "find_tools_for_task" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
